description.narrative: Burkina Faso - Agriculture Project - Access to Rural Finance Activity: This activity will increase medium- and long-term credit in the four western regions of Sud-Ouest, Hauts Bassins, Cascades, and Boucle du Mouhoun. Specifically, MCC Funding will support: (i) an on-lending facility to provide medium- to long-term loans, particularly to farmers and small- and medium-sized, rural and agricultural enterprises; (ii) improvement of the capacity of participating financial institutions to profitably and securely expand rural lending; and (iii) increasing the ability of creditworthy enterprises in the region to access credit, including women-owned enterprises.
